classes.instruction: Come to a complete stop and wait until it is safe to proceed.
Do not enter this road or lane in this direction.
Slow down and stay in your lane as the road curves sharply to the left.
Slow down and stay in your lane as the road curves sharply to the right.
Reduce speed significantly as the road ahead winds in both directions.
Slow down and avoid sudden braking or steering as the road ahead may be slippery.
Reduce speed and stay alert for workers and equipment in the road work zone ahead.
Slow down and be prepared to stop and yield to pedestrians crossing ahead.
Slow down significantly and be ready to stop as children may be crossing the road ahead.
This lane is reserved for bicycles; motorists must not enter it.
You must turn right at this intersection.
You must turn left at this intersection.
You must continue straight ahead and may not turn at this point.
You must pass the obstacle or island on its right side.
You must pass the obstacle or island on its left side.
Follow the roundabout direction and give way to vehicles already inside.
You must make a U-turn here and yield to oncoming traffic while doing so.
Do not exceed 60 km/h from this point onward.
Do not exceed 70 km/h from this point onward.
Using your vehicle's horn is prohibited in this area.
Making a U-turn is strictly prohibited at this point.
Do not exceed 15 km/h in this zone.
Turning left at this intersection is prohibited.
Turning right at this intersection is prohibited.
You may not go straight ahead and must turn left or right at this junction.
Parking your vehicle at this location is prohibited.
Slow down and be alert for crossing traffic as an intersection is approaching.
Watch for vehicles entering from a side road on the right ahead.
Do not exceed 20 km/h in this zone.
Do not exceed 40 km/h from this point onward.
You may pass the obstacle on either the left or right side.
Be cautious of vehicles merging from a diagonal side road junction ahead.
Do not exceed 30 km/h from this point onward.
Cars and other four-wheeled vehicles are not permitted on this road.
Drive quietly and avoid horn use as a hospital is located nearby.
Do not enter the intersection unless you can fully clear it before the light changes.
Slow down and stop if a train is approaching at the railway crossing ahead.
A designated parking area is available nearby; follow posted rules when parking.
You must not stop or wait here even briefly.
Prepare to turn left or right and yield to traffic on the main road at the T-junction ahead.
Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians on the intersecting road before proceeding.
Bicycles are not permitted on this road or path.
Slow down and proceed with extra caution as there is an unspecified hazard ahead.
Loading or unloading of passengers or goods is prohibited at all times here.
Slow down and be prepared to yield to oncoming vehicles as the road narrows ahead.
Overtaking other vehicles is prohibited; stay in your lane until the restriction ends.
Be aware of changing road conditions and increased pedestrian activity as street lights are ahead.
Traffic flows in one direction only; do not drive against the indicated flow.
